messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — customer asks piling up for Optimize: quantization, smarter batching config, and prefix caching. need to agree sequencing and launch bar.
aj (Eng): +1. customers hitting token cost on large models. quantization seems highest dollar impact but it's risky (model quality + long validation).
sam (ML): quantization reduces fp16 -> int8 type costs ~2-3x for inference, but per-model regressions are nontrivial. requires eval harness and per-model quant profiles.
irene (SRE): batching is lower infra risk — we already have continuous batching code path, improving heuristics and adaptive batch windows would give big throughput gains without model changes. latency SLO impacts need careful measuring.
maria (PM): thinking RICE-style: reach, impact, confidence, effort. can we sketch rough RICE numbers here?
aj (Eng): sure. my quick gut:
- quantization: reach=7, impact=9, confidence=5, effort=8
- adaptive batching: reach=8, impact=7, confidence=8, effort=4
- prefix/KV caching: reach=6, impact=6, confidence=6, effort=6
(plain numbers, 1-10)
sam (ML): agree-ish. quantization confidence lower if we need custom per-layer strategies. maybe confidence=4.
maria (PM): if we compute RICE score = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort -> rough: quant = (7*9*4)/8 = 31.5, batching = (8*7*8)/4 = 112, caching = (6*6*6)/6 = 36
aj (Eng): whoa batching dominates the simple RICE calc. that matches intuition: big wins for far lower effort.
irene (SRE): also remember sequencing constraints: batching improvements can be shipped incrementally with safe defaults. caching requires KV store + eviction/invalidation path — more ops work.
maria (PM): customers asking specifically for quantization because of cost on Dedicated reserved capacity. sales/solutions pushing for quantization as a revenue play. we need to weigh customer-driven asks vs platform impact.
sam (ML): also quantify risk: quantization needs evaluation on prompt sets. propose gating quant rollout behind automated regression alerts and a per-model rollback flag.
aj (Eng): tech plan idea: parallel tracks — prioritize batching core + telemetry (A), then caching prototype (B), then quantization rollout (C). A->B->C. A gives immediate wins and buys time to shore up ML tests for C.
maria (PM): what's minimum launch criteria for each?
aj (Eng): batching: 1) throughput uplift >= 20% on our standard traces, 2) no >2% tail-latency regression under SLOs, 3) feature flag + per-route tuning in console.
irene (SRE): plus observability: per-batch size distribution, queue times, backpressure alerts.
sam (ML): caching: 1) correctness: cache key determinism for streaming and chat, 2) freshness/invalidation model docs, 3) measured cost reduction for read-heavy workloads.
maria (PM): quantization launch bar: 1) no measurable quality regressions on canonical eval suite (we should define threshold e.g., <1% delta on key metrics), 2) tooling for per-model quant profiles, 3) auto-fallback to higher-precision variant on failures, 4) end-to-end perf/cost numbers documented.
aj (Eng): timeline proposal: sprint 1-2 focus on adaptive batching + telemetry. sprint 3 start caching alpha, early adopters. sprint 4-6 ML runs quantization experiments, then gated rollout if metrics are green.
maria (PM): sounds reasonable. can we get estimated effort in team-weeks for planning?
aj (Eng): rough: batching core + telemetry = 6-8 dev-weeks (2 engineers full-time for 3–4 weeks). caching prototype = 4-6 dev-weeks including infra and SRE. quantization (end-to-end) = 8-12 dev-weeks + ML evaluation cycles.
sam (ML): plus model onboarding for quantization: another 2-4 weeks per model for testing in parallel.
irene (SRE): SLO/infra work can overlap with dev. need to allocate oncall buffer for rollout days.
maria (PM): prioritization decision: product vote? propose we lock on adaptive batching as top priority, caching as medium, quantization as strategic (blocked behind ML readiness). anyone strongly opposed?
aj (Eng): agree. batching first.
sam (ML): agree but insist we start collecting needed eval datasets immediately so quantization doesn't stall.
irene (SRE): agree. I'll kick off infra plan for caching so it's ready when alpha starts.
maria (PM): ok I'll update roadmap and customer comms: 1) ship batching improvements with telemetry (Q2 minor release), 2) caching alpha invite program (Q2 end), 3) quantization beta for Dedicated customers (target Q3) — all subject to gating criteria above.
dev-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/optimize-batching -> staging at 2026-05-04 02:15 UTC :rocket:
maria (PM): action items: @sam assemble quant eval checklist, @aj start batching tickets + perf harness, @irene draft caching infra RFC. I'll loop in sales for customer expectations.
aj (Eng): will post tickets and link perf baseline.
sam (ML): starting eval checklist now, will add representative customer prompts.
irene (SRE): RFC in my drafts, share by EOD.
maria (PM): thanks team — if we run into a big blocker for quant we pivot to more caching + routing optimizations. agree?
aj (Eng): yep.
sam (ML): yep.
irene (SRE): yep.
maria (PM): closing thread, will post updated roadmap doc after RFC reviews. :white_check_mark:
